I can see the issue! The cart-service pods in version 4.2 have labels with the new Helm chart template format:
- `app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service`
- `app.kubernetes.io/instance: cart-service`
- `app.kubernetes.io/version: 4.2.0`

However, the Service selector is still using the old label: `app: cart-service`. This mismatch means the Service cannot find the pods!
